description: Returns the payment terms for https://horizonpulse.dev/api/email/check (base $0.003; USDC on Base or Polygon); this tool never runs the check or pays. Pay the 402 over HTTP with x402 v2: GET ?email=name@example.com (one address per call). Email address check for one address: RFC 5322 syntax, MX records (null MX noted), SPF and DMARC records over DNS, role-account flag (info@, admin@ and similar) and a disposable-domain match. No SMTP connection is made, so mailbox existence is not checked. One address per call. Bad input or DNS failure: Not charged. USDC on Base or Polygon. On USDC on Base, errors are not charged, apart from the exceptions noted on a route. On USDC on Solana, and RLUSD on the XRP Ledger, a refused or failed request may still be charged. On Polygon (native USDC), a request is settled only when it succeeds (HTTP status below 400). Failed requests are not charged.
